grades.quote: Whether to disable RDTIME class instructions at the PLV3 privilege level. When this bit is 1, execution of RDTIME-like instructions at the PLV3 privilege level will trigger an instruction privilege level error exception (IPE).
grades.reason: Directly identifies IPE for an instruction prohibited at PLV3.

grades.quote: All privileged instructions are accessible only at the PLV0 privilege level. The only exception is that when the `RPERF1` / `RPERF2` / `RPERF3` in `CSR.MISC` is configured to `1` , the `CSRRD` instruction can be executed at PLV1/PLV2/PLV3 privilege level to read the performance counter.
grades.reason: Explains privilege restrictions and an exception to them, but does not identify the resulting exception.

grades.quote: In LoongArch, the application usually runs on PLV3.
grades.reason: Provides user-code privilege context but no exception behavior.
Describes alignment exceptions, not exceptions caused by insufficient instruction privilege.
